summary: Iter26 frontend-only smoke of the new Twilio SMS Test super-admin UI on /companies. All 8 review-request items verified end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL. (1) Header shows sms-test-open button rendered directly next to company-create-open. (2) Modal opens with all 5 testids (sms-test-modal / -phone / -body / -submit / -cancel) and the status pill (sms-test-status) reports 'Twilio is configured' via GET /api/integrations/status. (3) Validation 1: submitting phone '12345' returns HTTP 422 and inline sms-test-result rendered with red styling (bg FBEBDF) showing 'Phone "12345" is not valid E.164 (e.g. +18777804236)'. (4) Validation 2: pasting 400 chars into sms-test-body is capped at exactly 320 by native maxLength and the counter reads '320/320'. (5) HAPPY PATH — one LIVE Twilio send to +18777804236 with body 'iter27 UI smoke test' → sms-test-result rendered green (bg C9E2D2) showing 'Sent — status queued · SID SM24f3fd69fda2f972bb37afa7d1c3552b · to +18777804236'. SID matches the required /^SM[0-9a-f]{32}$/ regex. Success toast 'SMS sent — SID SM24f3fd…' fires (visible in screenshot). (6) Modal close after success: clicking sms-test-cancel removes the modal from DOM; re-opening restores empty phone (''), empty body (''), and no sms-test-result element. (7) Regression: companies-page, company-create-open, drift-monitor still present; 99 company-card-* cards, 99 tier selectors, 98 switch-in buttons all rendered without layout break. (8) Access-gating: gov-admin (admin@gov.sl / GovAdmin@2026) logs in without TOTP; no /companies link in sidebar; directly navigating to /companies redirects to /dashboard, and neither companies-page nor sms-test-open testids are present in DOM. Only 1 live Twilio send used, per the 2-send budget cap. No console errors from TwilioTestButton.jsx. No design or contrast issues.
critical_code_review_comments: TwilioTestButton.jsx (193 lines) — clean, focused, single-responsibility component. useEffect gates loadStatus() on modal-open which avoids an unnecessary API call on the base /companies render. Good.

TwilioTestButton.jsx line 29-35 — close() correctly clears to, body, and result on every dismissal (both X button and outer-overlay click via onClick={close} at line 76). This is exactly what the review requested for 'Re-open the modal → verify inputs are cleared'. Nicely done.

TwilioTestButton.jsx line 50-53 — error path stringifies non-string `detail` payloads via JSON.stringify. Prevents 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crash when FastAPI returns array-form validation errors. Defensive and correct.

TwilioTestButton.jsx line 74-77 — outer overlay div has onClick={close} but the inner <form> uses onClick={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()}. This is the correct pattern to allow click-outside-to-close without dismissing on form clicks.
TwilioTestButton.jsx line 133 — textarea uses native maxLength={320}. Verified in DOM — pasting 400 chars is capped at exactly 320. No need for onChange truncation.
TwilioTestButton.jsx line 180 — Submit button is correctly disabled while busy OR when phone field is empty (`!to.trim()`), preventing double-submits and empty-phone HTTP 422 noise.

Companies.jsx line 8 + 104 — TwilioTestButton is imported and rendered inside the header's action group with `flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap`. Layout is stable at 1920x1080; the flex-wrap will gracefully reflow at narrower widths (not tested at mobile but visually the wrap class is present).

Minor code-quality: TwilioTestButton.jsx has no `aria-label` on the outer overlay div. Not a bug (the X close button has aria-label='Close'), but adding `role='dialog' aria-modal='true'` to the fixed-inset overlay would improve screen-reader semantics. Not a blocker.
